title: Tech Note #4 - Save files
author: Roguelike-Engine103
selftext:
I kept the original 16-bit save file format and made it work on supported 64-bit systems, which means you can swap save files between DOSBox 1985 16-bit Hack 1.0.3 and 21st Century Hack! Super nerdy, but check out these screenshots:

[AMRA.SAV in 21st Century Hack's default view](https://preview.redd.it/i11cnupdy0ig1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=32ddc324f6c3ec1ea1b436f0ca0e41400c9398c4)

[AMRA.SAV 21st Century Hack - zoomed out view](https://preview.redd.it/chtfqx4my0ig1.png?width=1896&format=png&auto=webp&s=d757212f324f389cb96b66787cf5f8d891ba9cb1)

[AMRA.SAV in 21st Century Hack - Text mode](https://preview.redd.it/ac1kvvaqy0ig1.png?width=1914&format=png&auto=webp&s=cda2cb825a9b860fbf20877773213267b5431050)

[AMRA.SAV in 16-bit Hack 1.0.3](https://preview.redd.it/tqgyg344y0ig1.png?width=635&format=png&auto=webp&s=a2bf662878eda8fb0e32c5dc79fc54942143d029)

comments.author: Far-Bend3709
comments.body: Keeping the original 16  bit save format and making it portable across decades is ridiculously cool. That kind of backwards compatibility is real hacker energy .

replies.author: Roguelike-Engine103
replies.body: Thanks for the support! My passion is modernizing this game for a new generation of hackers! Hack 1.0.3 is to Nethack as D&D is to AD&D. It’s simple enough to get started, complex enough to keep you going. This version was the apex of Hack development combining the goodness of Jay Fenlason’s Hack with the community additions, namely Andries Brouwer’s. The game was perfectly balanced and will lend itself to cloud backed high score and bones files well if all goes well from a project perspective.
